description: Which datasets the benchmark runs on, and how each is split. Records are split by entity, so no entity spans two splits, into train / validation / test at the given shares of records. Each seed gives a different split and also seeds the methods. Skroutz (238,170 records) is not in datasets, so the default run stays at a few hours; run it with run-all --dataset skroutz. excluded lists, per dataset, methods that are not run and why; they are reported as limitations. run-all stops any run that leaves less than min_free_memory_mb of the machine's memory free (user's rule: always keep 2 GB free).

skroutz.supervised.random_forest: out of memory: an unlimited-depth 500-tree forest took 2 GB on PriceRunner and would need about 14 GB here
skroutz.graph_clustering.hierarchical: out of memory: a dense distance matrix per connected group, about 13 GB for a 40,000-record group at low thresholds
skroutz.embedding_clustering.agglomerative: out of memory: the same dense distance matrix per connected group as hierarchical
